items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And he had me bring my band out there, and we went out there and played. ... Emile Thornton.

ctx.x: No, he loved to party. He had them parties. And he had a big party, a long(?) party out there at his ranch. On the Northwest side of town. Probably about ten miles out there. And he had me bring my band out there, and we went out there and played. They had a big barbecue out there... Yeah. Emile Thornton. And Wes Wise... Several of them around here. They all knew me, because I played all around all these places -- hotels, everywhere around here.

So ...(?).... I've done better here than I did running all up and down the road in them big band times. I got to meet a lot of people here and I started to buy me a home. I couldn't do it when I was on the road, running around with them big bands. I started buying this old rat trap here. I need to fix it up now. I've been here twenty years or better.
